entities.summary: Andrew Delano Andrews is an American professional basketball player for the Cairns Taipans of the National Basketball League (NBL). He played college basketball for the Washington Huskies and led the Pac-12 Conference in scoring as a senior. After going undrafted in the 2016 NBA draft, Andrews has played basketball professionally in Turkey, Latvia, Israel and Greece.
